edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor establishing privileged control
msg.sender is hashed into the PoW digest and receives the minted balance
msg.sender balance is debited in transfer
msg.sender allowance is written in approve
msg.sender allowance is consumed in transferFrom
msg.sender allowance is written before an external call in approveAndCall
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner in transferOwnership
msg.sender is compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership
Constructor calls _startNewMiningEpoch to initialize the first mining epoch
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed supply
Constructor sets decimals
Constructor sets the locked flag
mint reads challengeNumber as a PoW hash input
mint credits balances[msg.sender] with the reward
mint accumulates tokensMinted
mint calls _startNewMiningEpoch after awarding the reward
mint calls getMiningReward to compute the reward amount
mint writes solutionForChallenge to prevent replay
mint stores lastRewardAmount diagnostics
mint stores lastRewardTo diagnostics
_startNewMiningEpoch increments rewardEra when the era supply is exceeded

_startNewMiningEpoch increments epochCount
_startNewMiningEpoch calls _reAdjustDifficulty every readjustment period
_startNewMiningEpoch sets a new challengeNumber from the previous block hash
_reAdjustDifficulty updates miningTarget
_reAdjustDifficulty updates latestDifficultyPeriodStarted
_reAdjustDifficulty uses ExtendedMath.limitLessThan to cap percentage
miningTarget and block delta arithmetic depends on block numbering and can be manipulated
getMiningReward divides by 2**rewardEra which rounds toward zero
getMiningReward depends on rewardEra for halving
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping

transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient

transferOwnership sets the pending newOwner
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner
